visual.description: End card with channel branding. 'The World With Numbers' channel name in Montserrat Bold centered, held for full duration. 'Sources in description' in Inter below. YouTube end screen safe zones: two rectangular placeholders (lower-right for next video, lower-left for subscribe). No fade-to-black — content stays fully visible for the entire 20 seconds so end screen elements remain clickable. Film grain overlay throughout. Clean, minimal — no charts, no data.

notes: Final scene — 20 seconds of end card with YouTube end screen elements. fadeToBlack disabled to prevent premature content disappearance. Channel name and 'Sources in description' text appear via blur-fade-in in first ~1 second, then hold static for remaining 19 seconds. No image assets — text-only end card avoids the brief image flash issue. Subscribe CTA is subtle per brand guide (accent underline only). No busy backgrounds.
